using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using global::HybridCLR.Editor;

using UnityEngine;

namespace DYSJ.Editor.HybridCLR
{
    /// <summary>Compiles, copies and validates Android HybridCLR artifacts.</summary>
    public static class HybridCLRBuildPipeline
    {
        const BuildTarget Target = BuildTarget.{{TARGET}};
        const string BusinessAssemblyFile = "{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll";
        const string ResourceRoot = "{{RESOURCE_ROOT}}";
        const string AotResourceRoot = ResourceRoot + "/AOT";
        const string BusinessResourcePath = ResourceRoot + "/{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll.bytes";
        const string BusinessManifestPath = ResourceRoot + "/business_manifest.json";
        const string PatchAotListPath = ResourceRoot + "/patch_aot_list.txt";
        const string BusinessScenePath = "{{BUSINESS_SCENE_PATH}}";
        const string BusinessSceneBundleName = "hybrid_main_scene.bundle";
        const string BusinessSceneBundleAssetPath = "Assets/StreamingAssets/HybridCLR/" + BusinessSceneBundleName;
        const string LinkXmlOutputPath = "HybridCLRGenerate/link.xml";
        const string AotGenericReferenceOutputPath = "HybridCLRGenerate/AOTGenericReferences.cs";
        const string AotAssemblyListBeginMarker = "// {{ AOT assemblies";
        const string AotAssemblyListEndMarker = "// }}";

        public static void GenerateAllAndPrepareHostBuild()
        {
            EnsureProjectSettings();
            EnsureRuntimeInstalled();
            EnsureRuntimeCompatibility();
            PrebuildCommand.GenerateAll();
            SyncPatchAotAssembliesFromGeneratedReferences();
            CopyBusinessArtifacts();
            BuildBusinessSceneBundle();
            SyncAotMetadataFromGeneratedOutput();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh(ImportAssetOptions.ForceSynchronousImport);
            ValidatePreparedArtifacts();
            Debug.Log("[HybridBuild] Generate All 与 Android 热更新资源准备完成");
        }

        public static void PrepareBusinessHotUpdateForAssetBuild()
        {
            EnsureProjectSettings();
            EnsureRuntimeInstalled();
            EnsureRuntimeCompatibility();
            CompileDllCommand.CompileDll(Target, EditorUserBuildSettings.development);
            AOTReferenceGeneratorCommand.GenerateAOTGenericReference(Target);
            EnsureBusinessAssemblyFitsCurrentAotBaseline();
            CopyBusinessArtifacts();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh(ImportAssetOptions.ForceSynchronousImport);
            ValidatePreparedArtifacts();
            Debug.Log("[HybridBuild] Android {{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll 编译、复制与校验完成");
        }

        public static void ValidatePreparedArtifacts()
        {
            EnsureProjectSettings();
            var businessBytes = ReadRequiredFile(BusinessResourcePath);
            var businessManifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<ArtifactManifest>(File.ReadAllText(BusinessManifestPath, Encoding.UTF8));
            if (businessManifest == null || businessManifest.assemblyName != BusinessAssemblyFile)
                throw new BuildFailedException("业务热更新产物清单无效");
            if (!string.Equals(businessManifest.buildTarget, Target.ToString(), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new BuildFailedException($"{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll 目标平台不匹配: expected={Target}, actual={businessManifest.buildTarget}");
            if (businessManifest.length != businessBytes.LongLength)
                throw new BuildFailedException("{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll 与产物清单长度不一致");
            AssertHash(BusinessResourcePath, businessBytes, businessManifest.sha256);

            var sceneBundle = ReadRequiredFile(BusinessSceneBundleAssetPath);
            if (sceneBundle.Length == 0)
                throw new BuildFailedException("内置业务场景资源包为空");

            var configured = GetConfiguredAotAssemblies();
            var listed = ParseAotList(File.ReadAllText(PatchAotListPath, Encoding.UTF8));
            if (!configured.SequenceEqual(listed.Select(record => record.Name), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new BuildFailedException("patch_aot_list.txt 与 HybridCLR Settings 不一致，请执行 Generate All + Prepare Resources");

            foreach (var record in listed)
            {
                var path = $"{AotResourceRoot}/{record.Name}.bytes";
                var bytes = ReadRequiredFile(path);
                AssertHash(path, bytes, record.Hash);
            }

            Debug.Log($"[HybridBuild] 资源校验通过: business={businessManifest.sha256}, aot={listed.Count}, target={businessManifest.buildTarget}");
        }

        static void EnsureProjectSettings()
        {
            if (EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget != Target)
                throw new BuildFailedException($"当前 Build Target 是 {EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget}，必须先切换为 {Target}");
            if (!HybridCLRSettings.Instance.enable)
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR Settings 未启用，请先执行 Tools/Hybrid 一键部署");
            var group = BuildPipeline.GetBuildTargetGroup(Target);
            if (PlayerSettings.GetScriptingBackend(group) != ScriptingImplementation.IL2CPP)
                throw new BuildFailedException($"{Target} Scripting Backend 必须为 IL2CPP");

            var configured = SettingsUtil.HotUpdateAssemblyNamesExcludePreserved;
            if (!configured.Contains("{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}"))
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR Settings 未配置 {{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}} 业务热更新程序集");
            if (!string.Equals(HybridCLRSettings.Instance.outputLinkFile, LinkXmlOutputPath, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                || !string.Equals(HybridCLRSettings.Instance.outputAOTGenericReferenceFile, AotGenericReferenceOutputPath, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR 生成路径必须位于 Assets/HybridCLRGenerate");
        }

        static void EnsureRuntimeInstalled()
        {
            var installer = new InstallerController();
            if (!installer.HasInstalledHybridCLR())
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR Runtime 未初始化，请打开 Tools/Hybrid 并执行一键部署热更新功能");
            if (installer.PackageVersion != installer.InstalledLibil2cppVersion)
                throw new BuildFailedException($"HybridCLR Runtime 版本不匹配: package={installer.PackageVersion}, installed={installer.InstalledLibil2cppVersion}");
        }

        static void EnsureRuntimeCompatibility()
        {
            const string compatibilityTypeName = "Native.Editor.Hybrid.HybridRuntimeCompatibility";
            var type = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()
                .Select(assembly => assembly.GetType(compatibilityTypeName, false))
                .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate != null)
                ?? throw new BuildFailedException("找不到 HybridCLR Runtime 兼容修补器，请重新执行 Tools/Hybrid 一键部署");
            var method = type.GetMethod("EnsureInstalledRuntime", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
                ?? throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR Runtime 兼容修补入口不存在");
            try
            {
                method.Invoke(null, null);
            }
            catch (TargetInvocationException e)
            {
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR Runtime 兼容修补失败: " + (e.InnerException ?? e).Message);
            }
        }

        static void CopyBusinessArtifacts()
        {
            CopyAssemblyArtifact(BusinessAssemblyFile, BusinessResourcePath, BusinessManifestPath, "embedded", "{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}.dll.bytes");
        }

        static void BuildBusinessSceneBundle()
        {
            if (!File.Exists(BusinessScenePath))
                throw new BuildFailedException("缺少业务主场景: " + BusinessScenePath);

            var outputRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(
                Application.dataPath,
                "..",
                "HybridCLRData",
                "SceneBundles",
                Target.ToString()));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputRoot);

            var manifest = BuildPipeline.BuildAssetBundles(
                outputRoot,
                new[]
                {
                    new AssetBundleBuild
                    {
                        assetBundleName = BusinessSceneBundleName,
                        assetNames = new[] { BusinessScenePath },
                    }
                },
                BuildAssetBundleOptions.ChunkBasedCompression | BuildAssetBundleOptions.ForceRebuildAssetBundle,
                Target);
            if (manifest == null)
                throw new BuildFailedException("构建业务主场景资源包失败");

            var source = Path.Combine(outputRoot, BusinessSceneBundleName);
            if (!File.Exists(source))
                throw new BuildFailedException("业务主场景资源包未生成: " + source);

            var destination = Path.GetFullPath(BusinessSceneBundleAssetPath);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(destination));
            File.Copy(source, destination, true);
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(BusinessSceneBundleAssetPath, ImportAssetOptions.ForceSynchronousImport);
            Debug.Log($"[HybridBuild] 业务主场景已构建为内置资源包: {BusinessSceneBundleAssetPath}, bytes={new FileInfo(destination).Length}");
        }

        static void CopyAssemblyArtifact(string assemblyFile, string resourcePath, string manifestPath, string version, string fileName)
        {
            var source = Path.Combine(SettingsUtil.GetHotUpdateDllsOutputDirByTarget(Target), assemblyFile);
            if (!File.Exists(source))
                throw new BuildFailedException($"未生成目标平台热更新 DLL: {source}");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(ResourceRoot);
            File.Copy(source, resourcePath, true);
            var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(resourcePath);
            var manifest = CreateManifest(assemblyFile, version, fileName, bytes);
            File.WriteAllText(manifestPath, JsonUtility.ToJson(manifest, true) + Environment.NewLine, new UTF8Encoding(false));
        }

        /// <summary>Exports raw business DLL files beside the Game package for CDN bootstrap loading.</summary>
        public static void ExportBusinessHotUpdate(string version, string outputDirectory)
        {
            ValidatePreparedArtifacts();
            if (!IsSafeVersion(version))
                throw new BuildFailedException("业务热更新版本号非法: " + version);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outputDirectory))
                throw new BuildFailedException("业务热更新包生成路径不能为空");

            var bytes = ReadRequiredFile(BusinessResourcePath);
            var publishRoot = Path.GetFullPath(outputDirectory);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(publishRoot);
            var fileName = $"{{BUSINESS_ASSEMBLY_NAME}}_{version}.dll.bytes";
            File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(publishRoot, fileName), bytes);
            var manifest = CreateManifest(BusinessAssemblyFile, version, fileName, bytes);
            var json = JsonUtility.ToJson(manifest, true) + Environment.NewLine;
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(publishRoot, "business_latest.json"), json, new UTF8Encoding(false));
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(publishRoot, $"business_{version}.json"), json, new UTF8Encoding(false));
            Debug.Log($"[HybridBuild] 业务热更新发布产物: {publishRoot}, version={version}, sha256={manifest.sha256}");
        }

        static ArtifactManifest CreateManifest(string assemblyName, string version, string fileName, byte[] bytes)
        {
            return new ArtifactManifest
            {
                assemblyName = assemblyName,
                version = version,
                fileName = fileName,
                sha256 = ComputeSha256(bytes),
                length = bytes.LongLength,
                buildTarget = Target.ToString(),
                generatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"),
            };
        }

        static void SyncAotMetadataFromGeneratedOutput()
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(AotResourceRoot);
            var sourceRoot = SettingsUtil.GetAssembliesPostIl2CppStripDir(Target);
            var configured = GetConfiguredAotAssemblies();
            var expectedDestinations = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var lines = new List<string>
            {
                "# Generated by Hybrid. Format: assembly.dll|sha256",
                "# These files are tied to the current AOT host and must not be regenerated for a DLL-only hotfix.",
            };

            foreach (var assemblyName in configured)
            {
                var source = Path.Combine(sourceRoot, assemblyName);
                if (!File.Exists(source))
                    throw new BuildFailedException($"缺少裁剪后的 AOT 程序集: {source}");
                var destination = $"{AotResourceRoot}/{assemblyName}.bytes";
                File.Copy(source, destination, true);
                expectedDestinations.Add(Path.GetFullPath(destination));
                lines.Add($"{assemblyName}|{ComputeSha256(File.ReadAllBytes(destination))}");
            }

            foreach (var stale in Directory.GetFiles(AotResourceRoot, "*.dll.bytes", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                if (!expectedDestinations.Contains(Path.GetFullPath(stale)))
                    File.Delete(stale);
            }

            File.WriteAllLines(PatchAotListPath, lines, new UTF8Encoding(false));
        }

        static void SyncPatchAotAssembliesFromGeneratedReferences()
        {
            var required = GetRequiredAotAssembliesFromGeneratedReferences();
            var configured = GetConfiguredAotAssemblies();
            var merged = configured
                .Concat(required)
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToArray();
            HybridCLRSettings.Instance.patchAOTAssemblies = merged;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(HybridCLRSettings.Instance);
            HybridCLRSettings.Save();
            Debug.Log($"[HybridBuild] 已同步业务程序集所需 AOT 元数据: {string.Join(", ", merged)}");
        }

        static void EnsureBusinessAssemblyFitsCurrentAotBaseline()
        {
            if (!File.Exists(PatchAotListPath))
                throw new BuildFailedException("缺少 APK 的 AOT 元数据基线，请先重新生成并打包 APK");

            var required = GetRequiredAotAssembliesFromGeneratedReferences();
            var baseline = new HashSet<string>(
                ParseAotList(File.ReadAllText(PatchAotListPath, Encoding.UTF8)).Select(record => record.Name),
                StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var missing = required.Where(name => !baseline.Contains(name)).ToArray();
            if (missing.Length > 0)
                throw new BuildFailedException("本次业务代码新增了 APK 未内置的 AOT 依赖，必须先重新打包 APK: " + string.Join(", ", missing));
        }

        static List<string> GetRequiredAotAssembliesFromGeneratedReferences()
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath,
                AotGenericReferenceOutputPath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                throw new BuildFailedException("缺少 HybridCLR AOT 泛型分析结果: " + path);

            var content = File.ReadAllText(path, Encoding.UTF8);
            var begin = content.IndexOf(AotAssemblyListBeginMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            var end = begin < 0
                ? -1
                : content.IndexOf(AotAssemblyListEndMarker, begin + AotAssemblyListBeginMarker.Length, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (begin < 0 || end < 0)
                throw new BuildFailedException("HybridCLR AOT 泛型分析结果格式无效");

            var result = new List<string>();
            foreach (var raw in content.Substring(begin, end - begin)
                         .Split(new[] { '\r', '\n' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
            {
                var line = raw.Trim();
                if (!line.StartsWith("\"", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    continue;
                var quote = line.IndexOf('"', 1);
                if (quote <= 1)
                    continue;
                var name = line.Substring(1, quote - 1);
                if (!IsSafeAssemblyFileName(name))
                    throw new BuildFailedException("AOT 泛型分析包含非法程序集名: " + name);
                if (!result.Contains(name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    result.Add(name);
            }

            if (result.Count == 0)
                throw new BuildFailedException("AOT 泛型分析没有返回任何补充元数据程序集");
            return result;
        }

        static List<string> GetConfiguredAotAssemblies()
        {
            var result = (HybridCLRSettings.Instance.patchAOTAssemblies ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                .Select(name => name?.Trim())
                .Where(name => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
            foreach (var name in result)
            {
                if (!IsSafeAssemblyFileName(name))
                    throw new BuildFailedException($"patchAOTAssemblies 条目无效: {name}");
            }
            return result;
        }

        static List<AotRecord> ParseAotList(string content)
        {
            var result = new List<AotRecord>();
            var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var raw in content.Split(new[] { '\r', '\n' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
            {
                var line = raw.Trim();
                if (line.Length == 0 || line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    continue;
                var parts = line.Split('|');
                if (parts.Length != 2 || !IsSafeAssemblyFileName(parts[0].Trim()) || !IsSha256(parts[1].Trim()))
                    throw new BuildFailedException($"AOT 清单条目无效: {line}");
                var name = parts[0].Trim();
                if (!names.Add(name))
                    throw new BuildFailedException($"AOT 清单存在重复项: {name}");
                result.Add(new AotRecord(name, parts[1].Trim()));
            }
            return result;
        }

        static byte[] ReadRequiredFile(string path)
        {
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                throw new BuildFailedException($"缺少热更新资源: {path}");
            var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(path);
            if (bytes.Length == 0)
                throw new BuildFailedException($"热更新资源为空: {path}");
            return bytes;
        }

        static void AssertHash(string path, byte[] bytes, string expected)
        {
            if (!IsSha256(expected))
                throw new BuildFailedException($"{path} 的 SHA-256 无效");
            var actual = ComputeSha256(bytes);
            if (!actual.Equals(expected, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new BuildFailedException($"{path} 的 SHA-256 不匹配: expected={expected}, actual={actual}");
        }

        static string ComputeSha256(byte[] bytes)
        {
            using var sha = SHA256.Create();
            var hash = sha.ComputeHash(bytes);
            var builder = new StringBuilder(hash.Length * 2);
            foreach (var value in hash)
                builder.Append(value.ToString("x2"));
            return builder.ToString();
        }

        static bool IsSafeAssemblyFileName(string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || !name.EndsWith(".dll", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return false;
            return name.All(ch => char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) || ch == '.' || ch == '_' || ch == '-');
        }

        static bool IsSha256(string value)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && value.Length == 64 && value.All(Uri.IsHexDigit);
        }

        static bool IsSafeVersion(string value)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
                && value.Length <= 64
                && value.All(ch => char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) || ch == '.' || ch == '_' || ch == '-');
        }

        [Serializable]
        sealed class ArtifactManifest
        {
            public string assemblyName;
            public string version;
            public string fileName;
            public string sha256;
            public long length;
            public string buildTarget;
            public string generatedUtc;
        }

        readonly struct AotRecord
        {
            public AotRecord(string name, string hash)
            {
                Name = name;
                Hash = hash;
            }

            public string Name { get; }
            public string Hash { get; }
        }
    }
}
